<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Password must be at least 8 characters</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Password must contain at least three of: lowercase letter, uppercase letter, digit, special character</span></div>

## Why it happens

In 4.3.0.57 every password must have 8 to 72 characters and at least three of: a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit, a special character. The password policy fields in **Security settings** are not applied yet.

From the release after 4.3.0.57, the password policy applies instead, with messages such as `Password must be at least N characters long.` or `Password must not contain spaces.`, listing every rule the password breaks.

## Fix it

Choose a password that meets the rules in the message. `Plant2025` meets the 4.3.0.57 rule; `plant2025` does not.

## Check that it worked

The password is saved.
